stories.title: La española asesinada en México era de Canarias y estudiaba Educación Infantil en la Universidad de Granada

en.title: The Spanish woman killed in Mexico was from the Canary Islands and studied Early Childhood Education at the University of Granada
en.summary: A Canary Islands student participating in an exchange program in Mexico was killed. Her university held a moment of silence to remember her.

stories.title: Macron visitará España los días 29 y 30 de septiembre

en.title: Macron will visit Spain on September 29 and 30
en.summary: French President Emmanuel Macron will make an official visit to Spain with his wife, meeting with the Spanish King and Prime Minister. This marks the first French state visit in eight years.

stories.title: Una incidencia nocturna con un vehículo de mantenimiento interrumpe la circulación de la línea 9 de Metro Madrid

en.title: A nighttime incident with a maintenance vehicle interrupts traffic on Madrid Metro line 9
en.summary: A maintenance vehicle caused technical problems that disrupted line 9 service on Madrid Metro. Service was suspended between two stations while the vehicle was being removed.

stories.title: Asesinan en México a una estudiante española de 21 años que estaba de intercambio universitario

en.title: A 21-year-old Spanish student on a university exchange is killed in Mexico
en.summary: Claudia Tacoronte Aguilera, a 21-year-old Early Childhood Education student from Gran Canaria, was killed in Morelos, Mexico, during a cultural event. Authorities are investigating it as a femicide.

stories.title: Asesinan en México a una estudiante española de 21 años que se encontraba de intercambio

en.title: A 21-year-old Spanish student is killed in Mexico while on an exchange program
en.summary: Claudia Tacoronte Aguilera, a student from the University of Granada, was killed in Mexico while participating in an exchange program.

stories.title: Macron realizará una visita de Estado a España los días 29 y 30 de septiembre

en.title: Macron will make a state visit to Spain on September 29 and 30
en.summary: The Spanish monarchs will host a state dinner for the French president, who will also meet with Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez at La Moncloa.

stories.title: Lamine Yamal desafía a Mbappé en la carrera por el Balón de Oro: “Este año me lo merecería yo”

en.title: Lamine Yamal challenges Mbappé in the race for the Ballon d'Or: "This year I would deserve it"
en.summary: The Barcelona forward contends that he and the Real Madrid striker are among the world's best players, but argues his achievements with the Spanish national team and Barcelona merit consideration.

stories.title: Macron visita España en la recta final de su mandato y en pleno bloqueo del acuerdo de cooperación entre ambos países

en.title: Macron visits Spain in the final stretch of his presidency and amid blocked cooperation agreement between both countries
en.summary: The French president will be received on September 29 and 30 by King Felipe VI and Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez during a visit occurring while bilateral cooperation negotiations remain stalled.

stories.title: La Princesa Leonor y la Infanta Sofía coordinan sus looks para ver la Fórmula 1

en.title: Princess Leonor and Infanta Sofía coordinate their looks to watch Formula 1
en.summary: King Felipe VI and his daughters Princess Leonor and Infanta Sofía attended a Formula 1 event. The princesses have inherited their father's passion for sports, previously showing support for Spanish national teams and athletes.

stories.title: Un hombre cuadruplica la tasa máxima de alcohol para conducir y asegura que fue por comer gazpacho

en.title: A man quadruples the maximum alcohol limit for driving and claims it was from eating gazpacho
en.summary: Police intercepted a driver who was performing unusual maneuvers on the road and found his blood alcohol level to be four times the legal limit. The driver attributed the high reading to consuming gazpacho.

stories.title: Asesinada una estudiante española en México

en.title: Spanish student killed in Mexico
en.summary: A 21-year-old Spanish student, Claudia Tacoronte Aguilera, was killed in Mexico. Authorities opened a feminicide investigation into her death.

stories.title: Asesinada en Morelos una estudiante española de intercambio

en.title: Exchange student from Spain killed in Morelos
en.summary: A Spanish exchange student was killed in Morelos, Mexico in an apparent knife attack. State prosecutors are investigating the death as a feminicide.

stories.title: El Ibex flojea en medio del revés global a las tecnológicas

en.title: Ibex weakens amid global setback to technology stocks
en.summary: The Spanish stock market faces downward pressure as technology companies, particularly AI-linked stocks, decline globally. Oil price increases add to market headwinds during the Federal Reserve's week of focus.

stories.title: Novo Nordisk cambia la marca a Novo

en.title: Novo Nordisk changes brand to Novo
en.summary: Danish pharmaceutical company Novo Nordisk, maker of Ozempic, is rebranding to Novo and updating its corporate culture.

stories.title: El precio del alquiler crece un 2,4% de media en agosto: ¿dónde sube y dónde baja?

en.title: Rental prices grow 2.4% on average in August: where do they rise and fall?
en.summary: Spanish rental housing prices increased 1.6% from July to August and 2.4% year-over-year, reaching an average of 14.36 euros per square meter monthly.

stories.title: Los valores del Ibex más afectados por el freno en la IA

en.title: Ibex stocks most affected by AI slowdown
en.summary: A broad correction to the artificial intelligence stock market rally is spreading as mounting pressures on the sector intensify.

stories.title: Tendam gana un 28% más y logra el mejor primer semestre de su historia

en.title: Tendam gains 28% and achieves best first half in its history
en.summary: Tendam, a textile group owning brands including Cortefiel, Pedro del Hierro, Springfield, and Women'secret, reported a 27.9% increase in profits to 59.3 million euros in the first half of its fiscal year, driven by sales growth and new store openings.
